paragraphs: A Salmonella outbreak linked to raw oysters remains open with 28 cases across 13 states and 5 hospitalizations reported as of October 30 [1]. Three Class I recalls of broccoli sprouting seeds sold nationwide have been issued due to Salmonella contamination: Heirloom Homegrown Green Sprouting Calabrese Broccoli Sprouts Seed (8oz, ASIN #B09P49WHHP, sold on Amazon) [2], Gardeners Basics Waltham 29 Broccoli Sprouting Seeds (1 pound, UPC 848137042889, sold online) [3], and Wild West Seeds Broccoli Seeds Green Sprouting Calabrese lot #4105 (50lb) and Waltham29 Seeds lot #4475 (50lb) distributed in multiple states [4]. Additionally, Vitality Works is recalling one lot (2025-26227) of 365 Whole Foods Market Standardized + Full Spectrum Blend Ashwagandha Capsules (120 count) due to potential Salmonella contamination [16].

HAIFA SMOKED FISH is recalling approximately 560 pounds of Cold Smoked Sprats due to potential contamination with Clostridium botulinum, which can cause life-threatening illness; consumers should not use the product even if it appears normal [19]. Once Upon a Farm is recalling all lots and varieties of Tractor Wheels Organic Toddler Soft-Baked Bars due to choking hazards, as the product can rapidly become dense, dry, and sticky when exposed to saliva [14].

Several Class II recalls address allergen concerns: Trader Joe's Crispy Rice Milk Chocolate Bar (UPC 00515092, distributed to eastern and southern states) contains undeclared wheat [8], Taylor Farms' H-E-B Backyard BBQ Chop Salad Kit contains undeclared soy and tree nuts (almonds) [18], and Jovy Gummy Worms Neon (1lb, UPC 712199083411) contain undeclared color additives [5]. Additional recalls include Wise Wife Brand Ground Cinnamon for elevated lead levels [17] and Brad's Plant Based Crunchy Kale and Veggie Chips Kale products for potential thallium contamination [12].
